delete.description:
Bulk Remove Project Memberships for many parties on the given Project. Currently, the maximum number of party IDs that can be processed in a single request is 1000. If more than 1000 party IDs are provided, only the first 1000 will be processed.

This endpoint can currently only be used to remove reference users from a project. It cannot be used to remove a user who has a login or to remove vendors.

items.description: The ID of the Party (reference user) to be removed from the Project

skipped_managed.description: Present only when the Groups feature is enabled and one or more requested memberships are managed by Groups. Those memberships are NOT removed; they are reported here instead (USER-2168).

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code for a group-managed membership.

reason_code.description: Machine-actionable reason; indicates the memberships are group-managed.

message.example: This project membership is managed by Groups and cannot be modified directly.

party_ids.description: Party ids of the managed memberships that were skipped.

code.description: HTTP status in screaming snake case (like BAD_REQUEST)

x-changelog.summary: Bulk remove reports group-managed memberships as skipped
x-changelog.description:
When the Groups feature is enabled, Bulk Remove no longer deletes
memberships managed by Groups. They are reported in a new `skipped_managed`
object (`code`, `reason_code`, `message`, `party_ids`) in the response and
excluded from `processed_ids`. Behavior is unchanged when the feature is
off.

x-changelog.summary: Group-managed memberships are protected from deletion
x-changelog.description:
When the Groups feature is enabled, deleting a Project Membership that is
managed by Groups now returns `422 Unprocessable Entity` with a structured
error (`code: MEMBERSHIP_GROUP_MANAGED`, `hint: group_managed`) instead of
deleting the membership. Behavior is unchanged when the feature is off.
